questions.question: What does Psalm 124 repeatedly say?
options: The LORD is my shepherd, I shall not want
Unless the LORD builds the house, they labor in vain
If it had not been the LORD who was on our side...
Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD
questions.answer: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side...

questions.question: To what does the psalm compare their escape?
options: A bird escaped from the snare of the fowlers
A fish slipped free from the tightly tangled net
A lamb snatched out of the lion's jaws
A ship that survived the raging storm
questions.answer: A bird escaped from the snare of the fowlers

questions.question: The psalm concludes that their help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
If it had not been the LORD who was on our _____, the flood would have swept us away.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and _____.
